$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-SAF-003 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §7.4 and the RF-SAF-003 inventory entry. Expresses safety escalation / referral-trigger STRUCTURE only for delayed deterioration after an initially stable period. Re-enters the safety pathway regardless of time since injury; a previous CLEAR / CLEAR_WITH_MONITORING does not suppress the new screen. No diagnosis, rehab, dosage, progression, confidence, or return-to-sport logic. No fixed observation period and no wait-and-see clearance. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.

input_contract.$comment: Structural trigger signals taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §7.4. Categorical only — no fixed timing window or observation period.

decision_contract.$comment: Safety escalation structure only. Re-enters the urgent/emergency safety pathway; a previous CLEAR does not suppress the new screen. No rehab authorization, no diagnosis, no numeric values, no asserted observation period.

notes: Mixed normative source; MUST. Evidence grade preserved per source: QRF-018 (C1). Decision re-enters the urgent or emergency safety pathway regardless of time since injury; a previous CLEAR state does not suppress the new screen (V3.1 §7.3 — safety status is a live property, not a one-time stamp). Per v1.2 §7.4 the published delayed case is evidence of possibility only, not an incidence estimate or fixed timing rule; no fixed observation period or wait-and-see clearance may be asserted, and the rule must NOT state that compartment syndrome is confirmed or excluded. Clearance only via a valid external assessment and referral-resolution object (V3.1 §20). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
